_meta.indication: Treatment of thrombocytopenia in patients with chronic immune (idiopathic) thrombocytopenic purpura (ITP) who have had an insufficient response to corticosteroids, immunoglobulins, or splenectomy

pivotal_trials.design: Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled study of weekly subcutaneous Nplate; enrolled splenectomized subjects
pivotal_trials.population: Adults with ITP who were refractory to splenectomy; eligibility required having completed at least one prior ITP treatment and platelet counts ≤ 30,000/mcl
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Incidence of durable platelet response (at least 6 weekly platelet responses during the last 8 weeks of treatment without any rescue medication; weekly platelet response = platelet count ≥ 50 × 10^9/L)
pivotal_trials.result: Durable platelet response: 16/42 (38%) Nplate vs 0/21 (0%) placebo; p < 0.01

pivotal_trials.design: Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled study of weekly subcutaneous Nplate; enrolled subjects who had not undergone splenectomy
pivotal_trials.population: Adults with chronic ITP who had not undergone splenectomy and had an inadequate response to corticosteroids
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Incidence of durable platelet response (at least 6 weekly platelet responses during the last 8 weeks of treatment without any rescue medication)
pivotal_trials.result: Durable platelet response: 25/41 (61%) Nplate vs 1/21 (5%) placebo; p < 0.01

key_safety: Most common adverse reactions (≥ 5% higher incidence vs placebo): arthralgia (26% vs 20%), dizziness (17% vs 0%), insomnia (16% vs 7%), myalgia (14% vs 2%), pain in extremity (13% vs 5%), abdominal pain (11% vs 0%). Headache was most common overall (35% Nplate vs 32% placebo). Serious adverse reactions were bone marrow reticulin deposition and worsening thrombocytopenia after discontinuation.
target_moa: Romiplostim is an Fc-peptide fusion protein (peptibody) that binds to and stimulates the thrombopoietin (TPO) receptor on megakaryocytes, increasing platelet production similar to endogenous TPO
modality: peptide (Fc-peptide fusion protein / peptibody produced in E. coli)

rems.type: Nplate is available only through a restricted distribution program called the Nplate NEXUS (Network of Experts Understanding and Supporting Nplate and Patients) Program; the REMS consists of a Medication Guide, communication plan, elements to assure safe use, an implementation system, and a timetable for assessments

advisory_committee.vote: Discussed at the March 12, 2008 Oncologic Drugs Advisory Committee; the committee unanimously regarded the safety and efficacy data as persuasive of a favorable risk:benefit

description.text: Added new indication for pediatric patients 1 year and older with immune thrombocytopenia (ITP) for at least 6 months with insufficient response to corticosteroids, immunoglobulins, or splenectomy

citations.quote: This Prior Approval supplemental biologics application provides for a new indication for Nplate® (romiplostim) for the treatment of pediatric patients 1 year of age and older with immune thrombocytopenia (ITP) for at least 6 months who have had an insufficient response to corticosteroids, immunoglobulins, or splenectomy.

description.text: Expanded indication to include treatment of thrombocytopenia in adult patients with ITP who had insufficient response to corticosteroids, immunoglobulins, or splenectomy

citations.quote: This Prior Approval supplemental biologics application provides for expansion of the indication for romiplostim to include the treatment of thrombocytopenia in adult patients with immune thrombocytopenia (ITP) who have had an insufficient response to corticosteroids, immunoglobulins, or splenectomy.

description.text: Added indication under the Animal Rule to increase survival in adults and pediatric patients (including term neonates) acutely exposed to myelosuppressive doses of radiation (Hematopoietic Syndrome of Acute Radiation Syndrome)

citations.quote: This "Prior Approval" efficacy supplement to your biologics license application seeks approval under the Animal Rule (21 CFR 601.90) for the indication of romiplostim to increase survival in adults and pediatric patients (including term neonates) acutely exposed to myelosuppressive doses of radiation (Hematopoietic Syndrome of Acute Radiation Syndrome [HS-ARS]).

orphan_indication.text: Romiplostim had previously been designated as an orphan drug product by FDA for chronic ITP

summary.text: Romiplostim was the first thrombopoietin product submitted to FDA and carried Orphan Drug designation; it was reviewed with input from a March 12, 2008 ODAC that unanimously supported a favorable risk:benefit, and was approved October 2008 with a REMS (NEXUS Program) and required postmarketing studies.

citations.quote: Romiplostim is the first thrombopoietin product submitted to FDA for marketing consideration.
Romiplostim had previously been designated as an "orphan drug product" by FDA.
Romiplostim was discussed at a March 12, 2008 Oncologic Drugs Advisory Committee and the committee unanimously regarded the safety and efficacy data as persuasive of a favorable risk:benefit.
we have determined that a REMS is necessary for Nplate (romiplostim) Subcutaneous Injection to ensure the benefits of the drug outweigh the risks

requirement.text: Conduct an "Antibody Registry Study" enrolling subjects who have received romiplostim and whose blood samples contain antibodies to either romiplostim or thrombopoietin, collecting follow-up platelet count and clinical data

citations.quote: To conduct an “Antibody Registry Study” that will enroll subjects who have received romiplostim and whose blood samples contain antibodies to either romiplostim or thrombopoietin.

requirement.text: Develop and maintain a prospective, observational pregnancy exposure registry study in the US comparing pregnancy and fetal outcomes of women exposed to romiplostim during pregnancy to an unexposed control population

citations.quote: To develop and maintain a prospective, observational pregnancy exposure registry study conducted in the United States that compares the pregnancy and fetal outcomes of women exposed to romiplostim during pregnancy to an unexposed control population.

requirement.text: Conduct a milk-only lactation study in the subset of women enrolled in the pregnancy registry who choose to breastfeed, to detect the presence and concentration of romiplostim in breast milk

citations.quote: To conduct a milk only lactation study in the subset of women enrolled in the pregnancy registry that choose to breastfeed their infants.
